goal: Growth-biased hybrid block: rebuild strength, gain size, maintain aerobic fitness, and reintroduce controlled explosiveness. Size remains primary; secondary running targets: sub-19:00 5K on 2026-08-22; 1:35 half marathon on 2026-11-22.

days.title: Full-Body Athletic Strength
description: Warm-up: 7 min easy cardio, squat-to-stand, band pull-aparts, push-ups, and hinge ramp sets.

Progression: double progression; add load only when presses, hinges, and pulls are all stable at RPE 6-7 or lower. Temporary low-back recovery constraint: cap loaded work at RPE 6-7 and stop if symptoms rise. Recovery constraint: avoid impact, fast push-off, and exercises that worsen next-morning symptoms.
Incline press, shoulder press, or bench press: top set 1 x 6-8 at RPE 6-7, then 3-4 back-off sets x 8-10 at RPE 6-7.
Back-friendly posterior chain: seated or lying leg curl 3 x 10-15 at RPE 6-7, plus bodyweight glute bridge 2 x 12 if symptom-free.
Pull-ups or chest-supported rows: 4 x 6-10 at RPE 6-7 paired with front-foot elevated split squat or hack squat 3 x 8-10 per leg at RPE 6-7.

Shoulder, trap, and quad finisher: lateral raises 2-3 x 15-20, dumbbell trap raise 2 x 12-15, leg extension 2 x 12-15, then weighted sit-ups 2 x 8-12. Temporary low-back recovery constraint: avoid loaded hinging and max-brace loading; use machines or supported positions where possible.
adjustments: Adjusted for temporary low-back recovery constraint.

days.title: Easy Bike Aerobic Substitute
description: Bike aerobic RPE 3-4: 25-40 min conversational; keep cadence smooth and pressure through the whole foot.

Foot prep: foot-intrinsic activation, short-foot / arch lifts, isometric inversion and eversion, sole-to-sole isometrics, and banded eversion or inversion within 0-2/10 symptoms.

adjustments: Adjusted for temporary low-back recovery constraint.
